definitions.factor: Factor multiplies local time-filtered covariance in closure deficit; all diagnostic fluxes remain physical and unscaled
definitions.flux_partition: Actual resolved+constitutiveSGS interior flux; excludes unmeasured numerical transport
definitions.historical: 7293 data from earlier source, same grid/seed/setup; equivalence tested explicitly for oneface300
definitions.profiles: Equal average of the two true 1800s averages per hour; native model heights retained
definitions.rmse: Unweighted at native levels0<z<=200m; interpolate only fixed1m median; descriptive single realization
definitions.scheduler: 7331 child processes and scientific outputs verified complete despite reported batch NonZeroExitCode; login-shell clear_console teardown reproduces exit0->1 separately; actual batchSHLVL was not logged
definitions.series: Arithmetic mean of 60 instantaneous samples strictly after hour start and through hour end
definitions.skewness: Ratio of hourly mean third moment to hourly mean variance^(3/2); omitted for variance<1e-6; not mean instantaneous skewness
